general.title: First locate the target object, then locate the target container.
general.principle: For pick-and-place tasks, first search for and obtain the target object, then go to the target container to execute placement.
general.when_to_apply: When the task requires placing an object on a container/furniture and the initial location is unknown.

general.title: Must be at the target container before placing.
general.principle: Before executing put, you must have already reached the target container/furniture location via go to; otherwise put may be ineffective.
general.when_to_apply: When the target object has been obtained and you are ready to place it.

general.title: Prioritize checking common support surfaces, then check closed containers.
general.principle: When searching for the target object, prioritize checking open support surfaces such as tables, countertops, shelves, beds, sofas, etc.; if not found, then check closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, etc.
general.when_to_apply: When the target object's initial location is unknown and the room contains multiple types of furniture/containers.

general.title: Avoid invalid examine and blind exhaustive search
general.principle: Do not use examine as a search action; if many containers have been checked and the target still has not been found, reassess visible support surfaces or whether the target exists, rather than continuing blind exhaustive search.
general.when_to_apply: When searching for the target object fails or the target has not been found for a long time.

general.title: Avoid repeating invalid actions
general.principle: When an action returns "Nothing happens", do not repeat the same action; change the state (such as opening/closing a container, moving location, taking out an object) and then retry. If `go to <location>` returns "Nothing happens", treat that location as unreachable and switch to another candidate location; if `open` returns "Nothing happens", the container may already be open, so directly continue put.
general.when_to_apply: When any action returns "Nothing happens" and does not change the environment state.

general.title: Avoid declaring completion before success is confirmed
general.principle: Do not output a completion state or stop acting until environmental observation confirms the final placement action succeeded; stop immediately after success and do not issue inventory or empty actions again. If the final put returns "Nothing happens", first confirm that the target location has been reached and then retry, rather than prematurely declaring completion or failure.
general.when_to_apply: After executing the final placement action.

台灯观察.title: Desklamp observation task execution flow
台灯观察.principle: For tasks of the “examine/look at X with/under the desklamp” type, first locate the target object and the desklamp; if the target is portable, pick up the target, move to the desklamp's location, then use the desklamp (use desklamp <id>) to complete the observation. If the target object is already on the furniture where the desklamp is, pick up the target object first and then use the desklamp; if the first table has no desklamp, continue searching other support surfaces (sidetable, shelf, dresser) while keeping the target object held.
台灯观察.when_to_apply: When the task goal is to observe the relationship between an object and the desklamp (examine X with desklamp or look at X under desklamp).

台灯观察.description: In desklamp observation tasks, do not use the `examine X with desklamp` action; this action usually returns "Nothing happens"; instead, pick up the target object and then use `use desklamp`.
台灯观察.why_it_happens: The ALFWorld environment does not support passing the desklamp as a tool parameter to the examine action; the desklamp is a fixed object and can only be turned on via the use action.
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: If you need to observe the relationship between the object and the desk lamp, first ensure the target object is in hand or nearby, then execute `use desklamp` to turn on the desk lamp, rather than `examine X with desklamp`.

台灯观察.description: The desk lamp is an object fixed on a desk or side table, not a navigable location; executing `go to desklamp 1` will return "Nothing happens"; you should directly use `use desklamp` at the current location of the desk lamp.
台灯观察.why_it_happens: In ALFWorld, only furniture and containers can be navigation targets; small objects such as desk lamps cannot be targets for go to.
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: When already at the furniture location where the desk lamp is, directly execute `use desklamp`; do not attempt `go to desklamp`.

台灯观察.description: The desk lamp is a fixed object and cannot be picked up; executing `take desklamp 1` will return "Nothing happens"; instead, bring the target object to the desk lamp or directly use the desk lamp.
台灯观察.why_it_happens: In ALFWorld, desk lamps are marked as fixed objects and cannot be carried.
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: Do not attempt to pick up the desk lamp; if the target object is carryable, pick up the target object and move to the location of the desk lamp, then use the desk lamp.

清洗后放置.title: Clean-then-place execution loop
清洗后放置.principle: For clean-then-place goals, execute a stable loop: locate the exact target object named in the goal (do not substitute a similar object such as butterknife for knife or pan for pot), take it, go to a sinkbasin or bathtubbasin, clean it, then go to the destination receptacle, open it if closed, and put the object in/on it. If the destination already contains a similar object, still take the correct object, clean it, and place it back rather than swapping.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: Use when the goal is to put a clean object into a specified receptacle and the object is not already clean.

清洗后放置.description: A clean action can fail with 'Nothing happens' if the agent is not at the sinkbasin or bathtubbasin. If cleaning fails, go to the cleaning receptacle and retry the clean action.
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: The environment requires the agent to be co-located with the cleaning fixture before the clean action is valid.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: After taking the object, explicitly go to sinkbasin 1 or bathtubbasin 1, then issue clean <object> with <fixture>.

清洗后放置.description: If the destination receptacle is closed, open it before attempting to put the clean object in/on it.
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: Closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves must be opened before items can be placed inside.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: When arriving at the destination, check whether it is closed; if so, issue open <receptacle>, then put <object> in/on <receptacle>.

加热后放置.title: Heat held object with microwave
加热后放置.principle: For heat-and-place tasks, after locating the target object and the microwave, take the object, go to the microwave, open it if closed, then execute `heat <object> with microwave 1` while holding the object. If the first heat attempt returns 'Nothing happens', take the object out of the microwave and retry `heat <object> with microwave 1` while holding it. Do not attempt to heat using non-microwave appliances (stoveburner, toaster, coffeemachine); these return 'Nothing happens'.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires heating an object and a microwave is available, especially if initial heat attempts fail while the object is inside or on the microwave.

加热后放置.title: Do not assume heating succeeded without confirmation
加热后放置.principle: Only proceed to the placement step after an observation explicitly confirms heating, such as 'You heat the <object> using the microwave 1.' If heating has not been confirmed, continue trying valid heating methods rather than placing the object.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: After attempting to heat an object and before placing it at the destination.

加热后放置.title: Move to destination before placing heated object
加热后放置.principle: After successfully heating the object, go to the target receptacle/location, open it if needed, and then execute `put <object> in/on <destination>`. If the put action returns 'Nothing happens', verify current location and move to the destination before retrying.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: When the object is hot and the goal requires placing it in or on a specific location.

冷却后放置.title: Cooling requires an open fridge and direct cool action
冷却后放置.principle: To cool an object, first go to the fridge and open it, then use the cool action with the fridge while holding the object; do not rely on putting the object into the fridge and taking it out as a substitute for cooling. A cool attempt while not co-located with an open fridge returns 'Nothing happens'.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the task requires cooling an object and a fridge is available.

冷却后放置.title: Do not assume a cool object is already in the fridge
冷却后放置.principle: If the task requires a cool object, verify the object is actually cooled by using the cool action; merely finding an object in the fridge does not guarantee it is cool, and taking it out without cooling may fail the task.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When searching for a cool object and finding a candidate inside the fridge.

冷却后放置.title: Search efficiently by opening containers and tracking visited locations
冷却后放置.principle: When the target object is not in the first few locations, systematically open and check cabinets, drawers, countertops, and other receptacles, keeping track of which have been checked to avoid redundant loops.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately found and many storage locations exist.

双物品放置.title: Dual-item placement: first take the first item and temporarily store it, then take the second item and perform the final placement.
双物品放置.principle: In two-object placement tasks, if only one object can be carried at a time, first find and pick up the first target object; if the target container is reachable, place it directly into the final target container; otherwise temporarily store it on a safe open support surface, then find and pick up the second target object, and finally place both objects into the target container. Prefer searching open support surfaces (table, countertop, shelf, sofa); the two objects are often on the same support surface.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When the task requires putting two items of the same type into the same target container, and the environment restricts carrying to one item at a time.

双物品放置.description: In dual-item placement tasks, if you already hold one item, directly attempting to take the second item of the same type usually fails and returns "Nothing happens".
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The environment restricts carrying to one item at a time, so you must first put down or temporarily store the current item before you can take the second item.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Before taking the second item, first put the first item into the target container or a temporary container to ensure the inventory is empty.

双物品放置.description: In dual-item placement tasks, putting an item into a non-target container such as garbagecan may cause it to be irretrievable later or cause the task to fail.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: Some containers may not accept items, or the item's state may change after being put in, making it impossible to continue completing the task.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Prioritize placing temporarily held items into the final target container; if temporary storage is necessary, choose a container from which they can be retrieved normally, and avoid using containers such as garbagecan that may be irreversible.

general.title: Search visible surfaces before opening closed containers
general.principle: For object-location tasks, first scan visible surfaces (tables, dressers, beds, countertops, shelves) for the target object before opening drawers, cabinets, or other closed containers.
general.when_to_apply: At the start of a task when the target object has not yet been located.

general.title: Open closed containers before inspecting or taking
general.principle: When a drawer, cabinet, fridge, microwave, or other closed container may hold the target object, open it before attempting to inspect or take an item from it; closed containers cannot be searched directly.
general.when_to_apply: When the target object may be inside a closed drawer, cabinet, safe, fridge, or microwave.

general.title: After picking up the target, go directly to the destination and put it there
general.principle: Once the target object is held, navigate to the specified destination receptacle and execute the put action without unnecessary intermediate steps.
general.when_to_apply: Immediately after successfully taking the target object.

general.description: If an action returns 'Nothing happens', do not repeat the same invalid command; verify the current location and choose a valid reachable receptacle or action instead. This applies to moves, opens, takes, and examines alike.
general.why_it_happens: The agent may issue commands for locations or objects that are not currently accessible or valid, or use a bare object name instead of the exact identifier, causing no state change.
general.how_to_avoid: After a 'Nothing happens' observation, re-check the current location and available objects, confirm exact object identifiers from the observation, then select a different valid action rather than retrying the same command.

general.description: Several failed or budget-exhausted episodes show the Executor repeatedly moving to invalid or already-searched locations, or arriving at closed receptacles without opening them. This wastes steps and prevents finding the target object.
general.why_it_happens: The environment may return 'Nothing happens' for invalid moves, and the Executor may loop on the same location or command without updating its search strategy.
general.how_to_avoid: Track visited receptacles and their contents. If a move returns 'Nothing happens', do not repeat it; verify the current location and choose a different unsearched receptacle. Open closed receptacles before checking them. Prioritize likely object locations based on object type.

台灯观察.title: Desklamp observation task: first locate and carry the target object, then turn on the desklamp at the desklamp location.
台灯观察.principle: For goals of the type “examine/look at X with/under the desklamp”, first find the target object and take it in hand, then move to the desklamp’s location, and finally turn on the desklamp to complete the observation.
台灯观察.when_to_apply: When the goal requires observing something with the desklamp, and the target object is not at the desklamp’s location.

台灯观察.title: Desklamp observation task: when the target object and the desklamp are in the same place, directly turn on the desklamp.
台灯观察.principle: If the target object and the desklamp are already in the same location, directly use the desklamp to complete the observation; there is no need to first take the target object.
台灯观察.when_to_apply: After arriving at the desklamp’s location, observe that the target object is also on the same surface or in the same container.

台灯观察.description: The desklamp is a fixed object; take desklamp returns “Nothing happens”, wasting steps.
台灯观察.why_it_happens: The environment models the desklamp as a fixed device that cannot be carried.
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: Do not execute take desklamp; instead move to the desklamp’s location and directly use desklamp.

台灯观察.description: If 'use desklamp' returns 'Nothing happens', the agent is likely not at the desklamp's location; the Critic should advise verifying position and navigating to the desklamp before retrying, rather than repeating the same command.
台灯观察.why_it_happens: The use action requires the agent to be co-located with the desklamp; issuing it from elsewhere produces no state change.
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: After a failed use desklamp, advise checking current location and moving to the desklamp, then using it. Do not repeat the same command from the same spot.

清洗后放置.title: Clean-then-place workflow for placing after cleaning.
清洗后放置.principle: For tasks of the form 'put a clean X in/on Y', first locate X, take it, go to a sinkbasin, clean X with the sinkbasin, then go to the target receptacle Y and put X in/on Y.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal explicitly requires an object to be clean before placement, such as 'put a clean dishsponge in drawer', 'put a clean cup in shelf', or 'clean some egg and put it in diningtable'.

清洗后放置.description: Cleaning attempts can fail with 'Nothing happens' when the Executor is not at a valid sinkbasin or is not holding the object. The Critic should advise verifying both conditions before retrying, and try a different sinkbasin if needed.
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: The clean action requires the agent to be at a valid cleaning receptacle, typically a sinkbasin, while holding the object; some receptacles do not support cleaning for certain objects.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: Advise: hold the object, go to a sinkbasin, then clean. If cleaning returns 'Nothing happens', verify the current location and try a different sinkbasin. Do not repeatedly attempt the same invalid clean action.

加热后放置.title: Heat held object by placing it in an open microwave, then heating
加热后放置.principle: For heat-then-place tasks, first navigate to the microwave, open it, put the held object inside, and then issue the heat command.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires heating an object and the object is currently held in inventory.

加热后放置.description: Heating an object directly from inventory fails with 'Nothing happens'; success requires putting the object into the open microwave, then heating. The Critic must not declare the object heated while it is merely held.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The heating action requires the target object to be inside the microwave, not in the agent's inventory; the Critic may misread a failed heat as success.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: Advise: go to microwave, open it, put the object inside, then heat. Verify the observation text before declaring success; do not claim an item was heated while in inventory.

加热后放置.description: Recommending unsupported heating appliances such as stoveburners or toasters after a microwave failure leads to 'Nothing happens'; the reliable path is the open microwave with put-then-heat.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The environment may not support heating on stoveburners or toasters for the target object, and occupied stoveburners cannot accept another object.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: Do not advise stoveburner or toaster heating as a recovery. Direct the Executor back to the open microwave: put the object inside, then heat.

冷却后放置.title: Cool held item at an open fridge, then go straight to destination
冷却后放置.principle: To cool an item, hold it, navigate to the fridge, open the fridge, and issue the cool command on the held item; after a confirmed cool, go directly to the destination receptacle and put the item there without retrieving it from the fridge.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires a cooled item and the agent is holding the target object.

冷却后放置.description: Advising the Executor to put the item into the open fridge before cooling is wrong; in successful cooling episodes the Executor holds the item, opens the fridge, and issues 'cool X with fridge' directly, keeping the item in inventory.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The cooling mechanic works on a held item when the agent is at an open fridge; the item does not need to be placed inside and retrieved.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Advise: go to fridge, open fridge, cool the held item directly, then go to the destination and put it there. Do not instruct put-into-fridge-then-take.

双物品放置.title: Two-item placement: first place the first item, then take the second item.
双物品放置.principle: In a two-object placement task, after finding the first target object, first place it in the target container, then find and retrieve the second target object.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When the task requires placing two objects of the same type into the same target container, and the first object has already been found and picked up.

双物品放置.description: In dual-item placement, issuing a put action before arriving at the destination receptacle returns 'Nothing happens'; the Critic should confirm arrival before advising put.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The put action requires the agent to be co-located with the target container; putting from a distance cannot take effect.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Before advising put, confirm the Executor has navigated to the destination receptacle; if a put fails, advise moving to the destination and retrying there.

双物品放置.description: In dual-item placement, attempting to take the second item while already holding the first returns 'Nothing happens'; the Critic should advise placing the held item in the destination first to free the hands.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The agent can typically hold only one item at a time, so a take while holding fails.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Before advising the take of the second item, direct the Executor to put the first item into the destination receptacle, then return for the second.

双物品放置.description: In a two-object placement task, if multiple containers have been opened but the target object has not been found, prioritize checking opened containers and visible surfaces (such as countertops and shelves), and avoid repeatedly visiting locations already confirmed to contain no target object.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: Repeatedly visiting already checked locations wastes the action budget, causing the task to fail when the budget is exhausted.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Maintain a list of checked locations and prioritize checking unchecked opened containers and visible surfaces; if the target object is on a visible surface, pick it up directly.
